blind.description: A wooden apothecary chest of drawers featuring 30 small square drawers in five columns with metallic drawer pulls and label frames, above two wide lower drawers with round knobs. On the top shelf sit three lidded ceramic apothecary jars (reddish-brown, muted green, and cream/tan). The wooden structure is solid and clean with stylized, painted textures and rests on four integrated corner feet.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal rectangular wooden tabletop with a row of three circular jar lids aligned left to right (dusty rose/brown-red, sage green, and light cream), casting a long rectangular shadow with three rounded bumps behind it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 feet tall including the jars (around two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.5x off the catalog (4.4 x 1.3 ft)
